description: Copy of the org preset renovate/default.json in Miragon/github-governance. This repo is public, and the Mend Renovate App does not load presets from private repos for public ones.
Keep it in line with the org preset.

packageRules.description: @actions/glob >= 0.6 and @actions/core >= 3 ship as ES modules only. The action builds to CommonJS with ncc, which then leaves them unbundled and dist/index.js fails at start. Lift this once src/ is migrated to ESM.
